videos.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
videos.description: A big fan of the movie "Training Day" wants his '78 Monte Carlo to be built in the same vein; the G-body needs the works, including a swapped LS, beefed-up brakes and suspension and a new interior; Shorty's G10 parts runner van needs a facelift.

videos.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
videos.description: Shorty's right-hand man in the body shop, Joe Gomez, has been in remission from cancer for nearly 10 years and wants to create a wide body Honda Accord for his wife to show his appreciation.

videos.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
videos.description: After losing a grandson in a racetrack crash, Rick Wilson and his family want to raise money to promote safety at tracks around Texas; they enlist Shorty and the team to build a 1956 Corvette that will be auctioned off for their cause.

videos.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
videos.description: The '56 Corvette is complete, but not without a couple of twists; the family decides to change the body color from red to arctic blue with a silver teardrop; Shorty brings in the best in the business for a lowrider paint seminar at the shop.

videos.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
videos.description: Shorty's is traditionally a Chevy shop, but this week, a Ford collector who's always dreamed of a Shorty paint job convinces them to take on his '71 Torino GT; but what looks like a pretty straight car is hiding a can of worms underneath.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: Dan, Shea and Aaron buy a fox-body Mustang drag project that was halfway through a turbocharged LS heart transplant; with their eyes set on 700+ horsepower, they attempt to finish it within five days for a local "run-what-ya-brung" event.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: The guys transform a stripped-out Mini into a fully fledged spec car.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: The guys investigate an intriguing listing about a $3,250 Jeep Comanche.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: The guys resuscitate a Subaru Legacy while adding some overlanding goodies.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: The guys pick up an LS-swapped Silverado with some transmission issues.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: Dan, Shea and Aaron take on a stalled Nissan Skyline GTS-t drift project.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: Two brothers set out to build matching Track Rat Porsches; one lost interest due to lack of funds and time; with a Porsche racing pedigree and a not-so-stock surprise under the hood, Shea thinks this 944 is the perfect project to rescue.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: Dan and Shea drive out to Clovis, New Mexico, to buy the holy grail of JDM imports, a Toyota AE86; nostalgia aside, Aaron is skeptical whether it was a good buy, or even roadworthy.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: What was supposed to be an unfinished project feels more like a mechanic special; with problem after problem, it looks like this car was closer to ending up in a landfill than laying down 11s leaving the car meet.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: A shop owner's crew builds a SR20-powered Ford Ranger Urban Assault Vehicle, but when the turbo gives out, he knows it needed to go before it become more of a distraction; Aaron fixes the reliability issues; Dan and Shea go in on suspension.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: Shea, Dan and guest Wiley Stevens get less than they bargained for when a mess of a project car turns up and doesn't look anything like its photos.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: With Amir's help, Shea, Aaron and Dan rescue a rust-riddled 1989 Honda CRX from what would ultimately be the scrap pile.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: With an always-packed schedule, it turns out that Dan is no better than any other project car owner; he let his C5 Corvette fall to the wayside, but Shea and Aaron give him the final push to get his Corvette out of his side yard and into a car show.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: Aaron thinks a stalled RX-7 drift project checks all the boxes; the car has the makings to be a powerhouse drift car, with a surprise under the hood that makes this candidate all the more enticing.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: Shea, Aaron and Dan take inspiration from the original owner's plan for a Miata with shoddy welds and complete the ultimate version of what he intended.

videos.title: Runs Good
videos.description: This V-8-powered Subaru STI looks good on the surface, but needed a complete mechanical overhaul, with some extra little touches; given Subaru's pedigree, the guys get the build sorted and put it through its paces on the tarmac and the dirt.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: Former professional football tight end Chad Lewis desires customizations for his Audi R8 Spyder; a 1978 Trans Am needs tubs and wheels; a 1970 Dodge Challenger excites Kevin.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: The shop gears up for a big show and Dave's plans for an AC go south.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: Dave turns a client's outdated '53 Chevy into a modern, badass hot rod.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: The shop's talents are pushed to the max when a '33 Ford Tudor arrives.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: The crew attempts to make history as they make a truck that doesn't exist.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: Dave has his hands full trying to locate and build a 1959 Buick Invicta.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: The Buick Invicta build comes to a show-ready end after many challenges.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: The crew deals with a '32 Roadster mess from another shop.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: The shop must up their game to bring a '94 Impala up to date.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: A '54 Ford straight off the farm is turned into a hot rod milk machine.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: A client wants to update his 1964 Malibu to match the power under the hood.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: The newest member of the team modifies the hood of a 2013 Challenger.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: Muscle car fans rejoice as two classic '69 Camaros get the full treatment.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: Dave creates a plan to tackle a '68 Chevelle from the bowels of the shop.

videos.title: Bitchin' Rides
videos.description: A client asks Dave to transform his 1960 Cadillac into a copper hot rod.

videos.title: Dirt Every Day
videos.description: Dave and Fred try to get a crusty old Bronco running and out on the trail.

videos.title: Dirt Every Day
videos.description: Fred and Dave daydream of improving on a Humvee they built years ago.

videos.title: Dirt Every Day
videos.description: Fred and Dave blow the cobwebs off of the Mad Maxxis and the Dirt Pacer.

videos.title: Dirt Every Day
videos.description: Dave and Fred transform a trusty old Toyota into a Baja-influenced Ford.

videos.title: Dirt Every Day
videos.description: The guys are in Indonesia to build a truck that isn't available in the US.

videos.title: Dirt Every Day
videos.description: The guys revive the Dunkin' Dodge for a quest to seek the Holy Grille.

videos.title: Dirt Every Day
videos.description: Fred Williams and Dave Chappelle put the call-out on social media to let viewers vote on what truck to build next, and what type of adventure to take it on.

videos.title: Dirt Every Day
videos.description: The guys take an F-250 out on the trail, but find more snow than expected.

videos.title: Dirt Every Day
videos.description: Fred and Dave wanted big power for the sand dunes so they started with a drag truck with a rowdy V8; all they had to do was transform the rest of the truck into a dune-slaying machine.

videos.title: Dirt Every Day
videos.description: Fred and Dave deliver supplies to a friend who's been quarantined in Idaho.

videos.title: Dirt Every Day
videos.description: The guys take a 2003 Chevy for one last adventure in Western Colorado.

videos.title: Dirt Every Day
videos.description: Fred and Dave drive home a wacky stretched a CJ-5-truck-thing that wants to fall apart at every turn; the Dirt Heads won't give up on their goal to make it back to California.

videos.title: Dirt Every Day
videos.description: The Dirt Heads fix up Dave's red Chevrolet to clear 40-inch tires and head out to find bigger rocks; Fred and Dave order big rubber and head to Johnson Valley to attempt the Backdoor Trail.

videos.title: Engine Masters
videos.description: The crew dives into the relationship among cylinder head flow, liberal application of boost and horsepower.

videos.title: Engine Masters
videos.description: The guys run back-to-back tests with 87, 91, 110, 116 and even E85 to see if higher octane can make more power, and if an engine's optimal timing even changes with different octane.

videos.title: Engine Masters
videos.description: The guys outfit their Ford 363 with a Demon 650 blow-through carb and Holley's new Super Sniper Stealth throttle-body-style EFI to determine which will reign supreme.

videos.title: Engine Masters
videos.description: The guys find out if mandrel-bent exhaust pipes really make more power over the crimped and crunched pipes the local shop bends up.

videos.title: Engine Masters
videos.description: The crew tests 10 different filters in a hunt for the best units available.

videos.title: Engine Masters
videos.description: The guys test five carb hats and see how orientation affects performance.

videos.title: Engine Masters
videos.description: The crew is searching for low air temps and big HP numbers as they compare the heat-extracting power of under-roots intercoolers vs. E85; they aim to bring up the entire curve by swapping the short-runner blower manifold for a tunnel ram.

videos.title: Engine Masters
videos.description: The crew auditions their 406 SBC with an out-of-the-box Super Victor, a port-matched Super Victor and an off-shelf Wilson-prepped version.

videos.title: Engine Masters
videos.description: Testing the headers, intake, fuel system and everything else that will be used in David Freiburger's Model A drag car.

videos.title: Engine Masters
videos.description: Holley carbs have been the standard by which all racing carbs are measured, but CFMs are equal; looking at the difference in power between the smaller-bore, narrower-set 4150 carb and the bigger-bore, wider-base 4500 Dominator.
